title: sc-archive-chat manifest
description: Manifest for sc-archive-chat. Merged 2026-08-28 from archive-check.schema.json when sc-archive-check was folded into sc-archive-chat: the check half's keys (delivery, gate, scratch, protected_paths, concurrent_agents, extra_checks) and the routing half's keys (destinations, unroutable, post_route, claim_skill, compose_skill) now share one file, because one skill reads both. `destinations` is needed for routing only. --check requires none of it, and the check half works with no manifest at all, which is why nothing here is globally required.

destinations.description: Each kind of outcome and its durable home.

unroutable.description: What happens to a finding with no declared destination. Defaults to blocker: archiving around an unroutable finding is how work is lost.

delivery.description: Delivery policy. Default: pr when the root has a git remote, else commit.

gate.description: Verification command. Default: none, and nothing is claimed to pass without one.

scratch.description: Globs that count as leftovers when untracked and attributed to this session.

protected_paths.description: Never staged, cleaned or reverted by this skill.

concurrent_agents.description: This repo is routinely worked by several agents at once. Default true: always attribute before judging.
